title: Ordered completed exchange equals the completion-unit-conjugated ordinary mate
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g')$ be a cartesian square of these schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$ proper, and let $K\in\mathcal I_X$, retaining any choice of its compatible etale-origin witnesses. Put $M=Lg_A^*Rf_{*,A}K$ and $N=Rf'_{*,A}Lg_A'^*K$, using ordinary ambient operations, and let $e:M\to N$ be their unit-square-counit mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let $\gamma_g:M\to Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_{*,A}K$ and $\gamma_{g'}:Lg_A'^*K\to Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ be the specified completion units of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. They are isomorphisms and the ordered completed exchange of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] satisfies the equality
$$\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}=(Rf'_{*,A}\gamma_{g'})\,e\,\gamma_g^{-1}.$$
This is equality for the specified strict-tower map and its actual endpoint comparisons, with no assertion that $e$ or exchange is invertible.
